snippet.title: Painkiller - Slay Together Trailer
snippet.description:
Fast, brutal, and unapologetic, the unbridled chaos of battle awaits you. Gather your team of Champions and bathe the halls of Purgatory in the entrails of the unholy. This demonic infestation isn’t going to eviscerate itself.

Pre-order now and be among the first to kick in the gates of Purgatory: 

🖤 Steam: https://sabr.gg/PK-Steam
💙 PlayStation 5: https://sabr.gg/PK-PlayStation
💚 Xbox Series X|S: https://sabr.gg/PK-Xbox
